plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 169 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.01561, -125.35034, pull off on Ootsa Extension FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.9 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 52 m, about 124 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 180 m N of the spot at 1,084 m (52.96444, -125.36371). Water: unnamed wetland 90 m SW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-1, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.
R6F-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-1: about 1,996 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.35 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
